admissions.text:
When the user gives you an issue or a change under review (a pull or merge request) to work on, fix, investigate or review, when you open one for this work, and when the work resolves one, link it to this session with the openchamber tool's session.link as soon as you know it, so the user sees it with the session. Not one merely mentioned in passing.

When the user hands you a new task in a checkout whose branch already carries an open pull request or uncommitted changes that are not yours, offer to move this session into a new worktree with the openchamber tool's session.moveToWorktree and wait for the user's yes; move at once only when the user asked for a worktree themselves.
